purple-sunset-now-kitty-has-a-job-root.description: Job search copilot that scores a posting for fit, tailors the user's .docx CV according to best practices, logs applications in a tracker (Notion or local CSV), syncs statuses from Gmail, reports funnel stats. Use when the user shares a job posting, asks "should I apply", to tailor their CV, for application stats, to set up or sync their tracker, says "hello kitty" (starts setup), or asks for a cat fact. Not for cover letters, interview prep, salary negotiation or career advice.
